descriptionHtml: The Redragon Harrow G808 is a 2.4GHz wireless gaming controller designed for PC featuring dual vibration motors, 12-16 programmable buttons (including Turbo), and an ergonomic design. It offers up to 40 hours of playtime from a 600mAh rechargeable battery, with a 10-meter range.
